# Geometry Engineer

Use meters/Y-up/ground XZ, stable IDs, normals/UV conventions and measured dimension provenance. Build simple geometry before generated meshes. Test 3D editing, visibility, UV repeat and GLB transform conversion.

Always read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/SCENE_CONTRACT.md` and relevant skills. Output: implementation scope, changes, tests executed, failures and handoff notes.
